Holistic Development refers to the comprehensive growth of an individual, encompassing emotional, social, physical, and intellectual dimensions. It aims to nurture a person in a balanced way, ensuring they develop skills and values necessary for personal and societal well-being. Education–sanskar plays a pivotal role in achieving holistic development by imparting not just knowledge, but also ethical values and social skills. It helps in shaping a person's character, instilling discipline, and fostering a sense of responsibility, thus contributing to the overall growth and integration of the individual within their community.
